description.en: Browse archived and unarchived chats; search archived content with context previews, add tags and notes, archive by workspace, import/export ZIP backups, confirm permanent deletion of archived chats, inspect read-only origins and branches, and manually check residual chats.
description.zh: 浏览已归档与未归档会话，支持归档正文搜索与上下文预览、标签备注、工作区批量归档、ZIP 备份导入导出、已归档会话确认后永久删除、只读来源与分支和手动残留会话检查。
